reason: The cited evidence shows that Ti/Ni coatings and SPS improve interfacial bonding and density in HEA/diamond and AZ91-HEA systems, but none of the passages involve W-Cu composites or measure thermal conductivity, leaving the key premises about material system transferability and thermal property enhancement unsupported.
premises: Ti/Ni coating improves interfacial bonding between reinforcement and matrix
Spark plasma sintering (SPS) with coated particles reduces interfacial voids and increases density
Improved interfacial bonding and density enhance thermal conductivity
The coating and SPS process are applicable to W-Cu composites
A 30% improvement in thermal conductivity is achievable
